content.comment_body: Hello everyone, does anyone know if the memory/battery card [article_no] I'm testing in the [article_no] 12/24RC charges when power is connected to the device? The info I found for these cards indicates their battery component lasts for 2 years, but it's not clear whether the battery is charged while the device is powered. I'm hoping to avoid installing hundreds of [article_no] devices with MEM/BATT cards, only to have to replace them after 2 years due to battery depletion, which would leave me relying on the internal battery of the [article_no] (said to last 80 hours without power). Thanks, [user_name]

Hi, The backup time is 2 years, referring to the supported duration without power, not the overall battery life. You can leave the device without power for up to 2 years and the battery should maintain backup voltage. So, you don't need to replace them every 2 years. As with any batteries, their backup capacity will decrease over time, but it should provide coverage for several days of power outage. Regards,

Thank you [user_name], I misunderstood the '2 year' specification. Now that it's clarified, my next question is: What is the estimated shelf life of the battery? I understand this can vary, but could it potentially last around 4 years if only lightly used? There's limited information available on this. Thanks again.

Hi, I've attached the brand and type of battery used in the module. You might find additional information with these details. In my opinion, lasting 4 years or more is realistic, since the battery is mainly utilized for charging the internal capacitor when it's depleted after 80 hours. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: There was uncertainty among users about whether the memory/battery card used in certain programmable controllers is actively recharged while the device is powered, and confusion between backup duration and actual battery lifespan. Users sought clarity on shelf life and operational longevity due to concerns about the feasibility and maintenance workload when deploying a large number of devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want definitive information regarding whether the battery card recharges during operation, as well as reliable data reflecting both backup and shelf lifespans, to help reduce maintenance burden in large deployments.
